FX-POWERPIN-001.says: The settings as they start: the drawing, untouched, and nothing grows.

FX-POWERPIN-002.says: Shrunk to the middle, the pins at (25, 25), (75, 25), (25, 75) and (75, 75): the drawing at half its size in the middle, as Corner Pin draws it.

FX-POWERPIN-003.says: A keystone, Top Left at (25, 0) and Top Right at (75, 0), Perspective 100: the drawing leans back as Corner Pin leans it, its far upper half drawn smaller, so the blue band lands in rows 2 and 3.

FX-POWERPIN-004.says: The same keystone at Perspective 0: squeezed evenly instead, every row as tall as before, so the band stays in rows 4 and 5.

FX-POWERPIN-005.says: The same keystone at Perspective 50: half way between.

FX-POWERPIN-006.says: Unstretch on, the pins shrunk to the middle: the other way round, the middle of the drawing stretched out to fill it, twice the size.

FX-POWERPIN-007.says: Unstretch on with the keystone: the keystone's shape stretched out to fill the drawing, its top widened.

FX-POWERPIN-008.says: The pins shrunk to the middle and every expansion 50: the pinned shape grown back out by half of it on each side, which is the whole drawing: the drawing, untouched.

FX-POWERPIN-009.says: Expansion Left -25 with the pins where they start: the left side pulled in a quarter of the way, the drawing squeezed into columns 4 to 15.

FX-POWERPIN-010.says: Expansion Right 50 and Bottom 50 with the pins where they start: the drawing grown half as much again to the right and down from its top left corner; the layer grows to hold it.

FX-POWERPIN-011.says: Top Right at (100, 100) and Bottom Right at (100, 0), crossed like a bow tie: no drawable shape, so the frame is clear.

FX-POWERPIN-012.says: The left side squeezed small and far away, Top Left at (0, 45) and Bottom Left at (0, 55), so the right side is the near one, and Expansion Right 100 at Perspective 100: the near side grown by the drawing's whole width would run past the vanishing line, so the frame is clear.

FX-POWERPIN-013.says: The same at Perspective 0: squeezed evenly there is no vanishing line, and the grown shape is drawn.

FX-POWERPIN-014.says: The keystone with Perspective keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 FX-POWERPIN-004, frame 2 FX-POWERPIN-005 and frame 4 FX-POWERPIN-003.

FX-POWERPIN-015.says: Top Right keyed from (100, 0) at frame 0 to (100, 50) at frame 4 at Perspective 0: frame 0 the drawing, then its right side ever shorter, squeezed evenly.

FX-POWERPIN-016.says: Top Left pulled out to (-25, 0), the layer moved three pixels right, Perspective 100: the layer grows four pixels each side as Corner Pin's FX-PIN-006 does, and the frame is Corner Pin's.

FX-POWERPIN-017.says: Expansion Top keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4, eased past its end: frame 2 would pass 100 and is held there, the same as frame 4.

FX-POWERPIN-018.says: Unstretch on with the keystone at Perspective 0, the layer moved two pixels right: the evenly squeezed keystone stretched back out; nothing grows.

FX-POWERPIN-019.says: Perspective 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-POWERPIN-020.says: Perspective -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-POWERPIN-021.says: Expansion Top 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-POWERPIN-022.says: Expansion Left -41, below -40. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-POWERPIN-023.says: Unstretch "yes", not a word it takes. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-POWERPIN-024.says: Top Left at (-401, 0), its x below -400. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-POWERPIN-025.says: Bottom Right keyed to (100, 600) at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
